effective_contract_rule: all base-contract requirements remain exact except the named change_scope objects, which are replaced by this closed successor

fresh_hint_v2.admission: strict exact-shape/range validation followed by runtime computation of UTF-8 bytes from authoritative expanded message and validated JavaScript UTF-16 boundary; source_count is producer-attested structural metadata
fresh_hint_v2.failure: all schema/key/type/range/boundary/surrogate/scalar failures map to fresh_hint_invalid; never persist or overwrite; ordinary V4/chat/provider/tools/interactions/base RunBundle continues
fresh_hint_v2.independent_authority_limit: runtime independently verifies boundary range/scalar safety and computes utf8_bytes; it does not independently infer template semantic provenance or command count
fresh_hint_v2.prefix_utf16_code_units: positive JSON safe integer; bool forbidden; JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit boundary within authoritative message; may not split a valid surrogate pair
fresh_hint_v2.privacy: content-free; no composer/rawText/raw content/command/name/toolkit/id/path/URL/digest/hash/arbitrary label/contribution array/utf8_bytes claim/extra key
fresh_hint_v2.source_count: positive JSON safe integer; bool forbidden; renderer-attested and structurally validated only
fresh_hint_v2.strict_scalar_prefix: unpaired surrogate in selected prefix is invalid; strict UTF-8 only; no replacement encoding
fresh_hint_v2.v1_input: unsupported at the v2 boundary; composition-only fresh_hint_invalid; no heuristic upgrade or dual parser

private_projection.output: existing one-item skills/expanded_invocation/messages tuple with runtime-computed utf8_bytes and structurally admitted source_count
private_projection.rule: atomic mint only after valid v2 admission; exact private bytes/semantics remain unchanged
